title: Numbers Eleven to Twenty
label: ch:it-numbers-eleven-to-twenty
canDo: I can count from eleven to twenty in Italian and hear the ten jump to the front at diciassette.

payoff.summary: Run undici to venti, listen for the turn from se-dici to dici-assette where the ten moves to the front, and place Italian's break at 17 beside Portuguese's at 16.
